learning_outcomes.text: Students who have attended the module "Experimental Electrical Engineering" expand their knowledge and skills through a practical approach to electrical engineering. They receive an introduction to the topics of electrical engineering as well as an overview of the curriculum, which is closely linked to the practical aspects of electrical engineering. The introduction to the electrical engineering laboratories allows students to apply theoretical concepts in practice and to carry out various experiments. Through excursions to regional companies (depending on availability), they also gain insights into the applications of electrical engineering in industry.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the topics of electrical engineering
Connection of the curriculum with the topics of electrical engineering
Introduction to the electrical engineering laboratories of the university
Conducting experiments in the individual laboratories
Excursions to regional companies (depending on availability)
teaching_methods: Participation in the study preparation week
assessment_rules: Regular participation requires attendance of at least 80% of the course.
